mentions.claim_text: He explains the Sooners as those who took land before the Oklahoma land run, says he saw a wagon crossing the land, and that the Lord said Japan and South Korea would be first, with Asia going all in on crypto.
mentions.quote: the Lord said the Japan and the Sooners will be first
mentions.falsify_match: Japan and South Korea legislate on crypto ahead of the United States.

mentions.claim_text: He points to Japan officially passing laws recognising crypto as a financial instrument as the fulfilment, and contrasts it with American senators he calls dumb.
mentions.quote: Japan officially passes laws recognizing crypto as a financial
mentions.falsify_match: Japanese crypto legislation precedes American legislation.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Japan's FIEA reclassification had been in progress publicly since early 2025.

mentions.claim_text: After a side exchange about how two words sound similar, he returns to the word about the Sooners being South Korea.
mentions.quote: after the Lord spoke to us about the Sooners
mentions.falsify_match: South Korea moves on crypto ahead of America.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the pink currency again, Iraq and Babylon rising, palm trees and Rolls-Royces, and says Iraq is coming like Saudi Arabia into a new era built around the oil.
mentions.quote: I see Iraq coming like Saudi Arabia again
mentions.falsify_match: Iraqi wealth and living standards approach Gulf state levels.

mentions.claim_text: He sees three faces in Iraq, one heavier set with a black moustache and a five o'clock shadow whom he compares to a younger Saddam Hussein before he looked crazy.
mentions.quote: One has a black mustache. He's heavier set
mentions.falsify_match: Three identifiable Iraqi figures matching those descriptions come to prominence.
mentions.falsify_miss: No match. A moustache and a five o'clock shadow fits a large share of Iraqi male politicians.

mentions.claim_text: He is shown a report that a historic five hundred mile pipeline to Syria's Mediterranean coast will be revived to bypass the Strait of Hormuz, with multiple pipelines ramping up to circumvent Iran.
mentions.quote: revive that historic 500 mile pipeline to Syria's Mediterranean coast
mentions.falsify_match: The Kirkuk to Baniyas pipeline is rebuilt and carries oil.
mentions.falsify_miss: The project stalls, as previous revivals of it have.

mentions.claim_text: He says American companies are doing the work and that they will set Iran back further into the stone age with an attack coming against its infrastructure and its electric grid.
mentions.quote: they will set Iran back even further into the stone age
mentions.falsify_match: A strike disables the Iranian electric grid.

mentions.claim_text: He sees battalions and the arming of civilians, then hears Iran threatening to cut the underwater cables that carry the internet.
mentions.quote: I hear them threatening to cut underwater cables
mentions.falsify_match: Undersea cables are cut or credibly threatened by Iran.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are hitting a desperation point and doing something to bring forth a Mahdi, and that they have Israel in their sights and are trying to strike.
mentions.quote: it's about bringing forth a Mahdi. We must do this
mentions.falsify_match: Iranian leadership acts explicitly to precipitate the Mahdi's appearance.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are looking toward Israel and toward Syria, and repeats that Iran has one untested weapon he calls the black rocket.
mentions.quote: They have one weapon. It's not been tested
mentions.falsify_match: Iran is confirmed to hold an untested device.

mentions.claim_text: He says the man currently in place is done and another regime change is coming, that they do not want a civil war like Afghanistan, and that an unstable Iran is dangerous because of what they have.
mentions.quote: Another one more another regime change is coming
mentions.falsify_match: A second change of Iranian leadership.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over American troops regarding a ground invasion, and says the posture is to assist others around it rather than lead, with Saudi Arabia and other nations asked to get involved as the art of the deal.
mentions.quote: It's not our fault. It's not our problem
mentions.falsify_match: America backs an Arab-led ground operation rather than leading one.
mentions.falsify_miss: America leads, or no ground operation occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says Jordan and other nations are being asked to help bring a stable Iran, that an unstable Iran is dangerous to the region, and that Pakistan does not want to be involved with freedom fighters.
mentions.quote: An unstable Iran is dangerous to the region
mentions.falsify_match: A regional coalition forms with Jordan in and Pakistan out.

mentions.claim_text: Noting that his son edits out the tongues, he says what he saw in the vision was that Iraq is about to develop a major pipeline with America.
mentions.quote: Iraq is about to develop a major pipeline with America
mentions.falsify_match: An American backed Iraqi pipeline project is agreed.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is not a financial adviser and does not give financial advice, and that he wishes he could just talk about what he sees but cannot because of who is listening.
mentions.quote: I don't give financial advice
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a disclaimer.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says he called drones going from Iran to Cuba before anyone was talking about them and before they existed, and that he could say where they were delivered at the Bay of Pigs.
mentions.quote: I see drones from from Iran to Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: Iranian drones in Cuba are confirmed, delivered at the Bay of Pigs.

mentions.claim_text: He assumes the drones must have arrived under the previous administration, says they see in part, and notes that Pentagon officials are examining military options.
mentions.quote: I'm just going to blame Biden
mentions.falsify_match: The delivery date is established as during that administration.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. He concedes he is assuming.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for the troops on the night the grid goes down, and says the Lord showed him a building and that one of the leaks is a mole who was passing information to the man with the grey hair while pretending otherwise.
mentions.quote: One of the leaks is a mole and he's not a good mole
mentions.falsify_match: An intelligence leak to Ukraine from inside the American government is exposed.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the Cuban leader leaving by boat rather than plane, going to Haiti and then by jet to Mexico where the Mexican president harboured him, with pallets of hundred dollar bills and gold, and a stunt double who looked just like him.
mentions.quote: he had pallets of $100 bills and gold
mentions.falsify_match: The Cuban leader flees to Mexico with a body double left behind.

mentions.claim_text: He adds that there is an old military silo underground, that the leader got away while his stunt double died, and that the United States did not know at the time, correcting Haiti to the Dominican Republic.
mentions.quote: his stunt double died and the United States didn't know it
mentions.falsify_match: A body double is confirmed killed in place of the Cuban leader.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him there would be a specific attack against the president's life, that what is being reported now is a copycat and a false flag by a loser, and that he is not dismissing it.
mentions.quote: this is just a false flag. This is a copycat
mentions.falsify_match: A serious attempt on the president distinct from the reported one.

mentions.claim_text: He describes an operation costing millions, men who looked like special operations in black hats, moving at night through Canada into Michigan, contrasted with the online figure who was caught.
mentions.quote: it moved at night through Canada and I saw it Michigan
mentions.falsify_match: A trained team entering through Michigan is intercepted or acts.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Mexican president will eventually be removed and a man who looks like Antonio Banderas will rise up and take over Mexico, if the people pray.
mentions.quote: an Antonio Banderas looking man will rise up in Mexico
mentions.falsify_match: The Mexican president is removed and succeeded by a man matching that description.

mentions.claim_text: He says the problem is not the president but the preachers, that as American culture returns to God people will vote righteously, and that they are not hearing it.
mentions.quote: No, it's the preachers. We got to preach
mentions.falsify_match: A change in American preaching precedes a change in voting patterns.

mentions.claim_text: He prays the president take no counsel from ungodly people and warns against an alliance with Turkey, saying they are called friends but are the devil, and that the Turkish leader will come out like a vampire in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: he's going to come out like a vampire in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey turns against American and Israeli interests.
mentions.falsify_miss: Turkey remains a cooperative NATO partner.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a Jason Bourne style moment in which the Ukrainian president is taken out in the days ahead, high on cocaine with what looked like prostitutes around him, and makes clear he means Zelensky and not Macron.
mentions.quote: I saw like a Jason Bourne moment
mentions.falsify_match: Zelensky is removed or killed.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when you fear and reverence God the powers are weak, and that he has seen Satan going to meetings and talking to people with a lot of money, which he calls his wheelhouse.
mentions.quote: He talks to a lot of people with a lot of money
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the claim is about spiritual meetings.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has to pray in the spirit because of what he just saw over the president's eldest son again and over the Clarity Act, and that three visions came back to back.
mentions.quote: what I just saw over Don Jr. again
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt against the president's eldest son.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a teddy bear like a child's toy over Europe with a snake slithering toward it, then moves from Europe to America.
mentions.quote: I saw the snake slithering toward this teddy bear
mentions.falsify_match: The image resolves to an identifiable European event.
mentions.falsify_miss: It stays uninterpreted; he offers no reading.

mentions.claim_text: He sees Iran shaken across the land and a flipping of the script, saying attention will move to the homeland and to Cuba as alliances shift.
mentions.quote: I see a flipping of the script
mentions.falsify_match: American policy attention shifts from Iran to Cuba and domestic security.

mentions.claim_text: He calls for repentance, prays protection around the president, and declares that no weapon formed against him will prosper, that he will finish his job and finish strong with a legacy to be proud of.
mentions.quote: He'll finish his job. And he'll finish strong
mentions.falsify_match: The president completes the term.

mentions.claim_text: He says Israel got back all their wages in gold and silver when they left Egypt, and that there are seeds sown in the past that will come to harvest at last, which he calls retribution days.
mentions.quote: There's seeds you've sewed in the past that will come to harvest
mentions.falsify_match: Listeners report recovered losses at scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. The condition on past sowing makes any shortfall attributable to the hearer.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a new attack against the president's life and a black mamba snake.
mentions.quote: a new attack against President Trump's life. And I saw a black mamba snake
mentions.falsify_match: A further attempt on the president's life.

mentions.claim_text: He turns to a shooting at a Toronto street festival the previous night that killed people, before going on to what he saw the night before.
mentions.quote: We had a shooting last night in Toronto at a street festival
mentions.falsify_match: A pattern of Toronto attacks tied to cells he named.
mentions.falsify_miss: An isolated shooting with no such link.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not want flakiness or prophetic weirdness and does not want to add to it, then recalls seeing the Bay of Pigs two or three weeks earlier.
mentions.quote: We don't want no flakiness. There's too much flakiness
mentions.falsify_match: He continues to distinguish his claims from unfounded ones.
mentions.falsify_miss: He claims loose matches as hits.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw them going into New Orleans and Florida, and that they will use this in retaliation as a simultaneous attack with Iran and the enemy within, with Cuba as Iran's helper.
mentions.quote: they will use this in retaliation as a simo attack with Iran
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated Iran and Cuba attack on American cities.

mentions.claim_text: He says he heard chatter on a secret device speaking to troops already inside the country, which only broadcast at certain points of the day on a certain day of the week.
mentions.quote: I heard the chatter on a secret device talking to the troops
mentions.falsify_match: A covert communication network to sleeper cells inside America is uncovered.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a room holding many Latino men being tortured greatly with chemicals and psychological warfare, brought in one at a time.
mentions.quote: they were torturing these men with chemical
mentions.falsify_match: A torture facility of that description is exposed.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such exposure. He does not say where the room is.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a large bushy faced fox in a hat looking at him as he prayed, and a witch in a top hat that looked like a skeleton man, which the Lord called voodoo, marked symbolic.
mentions.quote: the Lord said, This is voodoo
mentions.falsify_match: The fox resolves to an identifiable actor.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He says he does not know what it means.

mentions.claim_text: He says a great shaking is coming to Cuba, that the Lord said a major revival is coming and he will liberate the people, and that the president was ready to move from the Iran conflict to Cuba, which would not last long.
mentions.quote: A MAJOR REVIVAL is coming. I'm going to liberate the people
mentions.falsify_match: Cuba is liberated and a religious revival follows.

mentions.claim_text: Applying the line about slaying tens of thousands and thousands to the vice president, he says he saw Rubio rise with great favour among Latinos and Cubans, with wealth and prosperity coming to Cuba at the liberation and people welcoming it.
mentions.quote: I saw a Rubio rise up with great favor with Latinos
mentions.falsify_match: Rubio gains prominence through a Cuban liberation.

mentions.claim_text: He sees alliances with Russia and patches of stars on shoulders he cannot interpret, and says a major event is about to take place in Cuba with a shaking over the nation, symbolic as earthquakes shake Cuba.
mentions.quote: earthquakes will shake Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: Notable earthquakes recorded in Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: No Cuban seismicity. Note eastern Cuba had a magnitude 6.8 in November 2024, so felt quakes there are not unprecedented.

mentions.claim_text: He notes something he says they saw on the fourth is now in the news on Fox that day, and offers it as prophetic accuracy rather than flakiness.
mentions.quote: So prophetic accuracy, it's not flakiness
mentions.falsify_match: The 4 July recording contains the specific item that later appeared.
mentions.falsify_miss: The recording is vaguer than the later news item.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Cuba retaliating against America, with the affected zone running into Texas and up to Oklahoma, almost to Colorado but not quite, and Missouri.
mentions.quote: the zone goes clear into Texas all the way up to Oklahoma
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuban originated attack affecting that geographic range.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that a fox is looking at them, at New Orleans and at America, that it is not a small fox but a big one, and that he does not know what it means.
mentions.quote: A fox is looking at America, but it's not a small fox
mentions.falsify_match: The fox resolves to an identifiable actor.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He states plainly that he does not know.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is warning of the plan of the wicked and calls for prayer over the nation for a great revival and a great shaking to awaken, then notes a report of Iranian drones in Cuba raised the previous day.
mentions.quote: warning you of the plan of the wicked
mentions.falsify_match: Iranian drones in Cuba are officially confirmed.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him great persecution is coming over Europe, over the Jews and over America in the days ahead, specifically New York, and connects it to the city's new mayor.
mentions.quote: It's great persecution coming over Europe, over the Jews
mentions.falsify_match: A marked rise in antisemitic persecution in New York and Europe.

mentions.claim_text: He says named ministries are bringing Jews home to Israel and that God said he would scoop them up, seen with a big net gathering them.
mentions.quote: I'm going to scoop them up
mentions.falsify_match: A large organised wave of Jewish emigration to Israel.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a new pipeline with the Kurds and Iraq's economy rising as Iran was defeated and greatly wounded, and heard stone age, taken back for a majority of the nation rather than the whole.
mentions.quote: They will end up taking them back to a stone age
mentions.falsify_match: A Kurdish pipeline opens while Iranian infrastructure collapses.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither happens. He qualifies it to a majority rather than the whole nation.

mentions.claim_text: He says much corruption is still in Iraq, and that he saw a pipeline discussed, Saudi Arabia, blessing, Rolls-Royces and cars for the Iraqi people, a stabilised wealth transfer and article 140.
mentions.quote: much much corruption is still in Iraq
mentions.falsify_match: Iraqi living standards rise sharply and article 140 is implemented.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither happens. Article 140 has been unimplemented since 2007.

mentions.claim_text: He says an unstable Iran is dangerous because of what is under the mountain, and that he heard the word kamikaze, with Iran entering a desperation of we are going to die anyway.
mentions.quote: I heard they are about to be kamikaze
mentions.falsify_match: Iran launches an attack it knows to be suicidal.

mentions.claim_text: He works out the meaning of kamikaze with his co-host, comparing it to Japanese pilots deliberately crashing loaded aircraft in the Second World War, and says it was like suicide and very dark.
mentions.quote: It was like suicide. It was something very dark
mentions.falsify_match: An Iranian suicide operation occurs.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The meaning is being looked up during the broadcast.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord used the words freedom fighters, that they will try to rise up inside Iran and the United States will arm them, and that there was a debate about whether to arm them so the citizens have a chance.
mentions.quote: freedom fighters will try to rise up and the United States will arm them
mentions.falsify_match: America arms an internal Iranian opposition.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the freedom fighters in poor pickup trucks like Ford F-150s with head coverings, saying they looked almost like Afghan people.
mentions.quote: they were in the back of these trucks and they were freedom fighters
mentions.falsify_match: Irregular armed groups of that description appear in Iran.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said boots on the ground, that Saudi Arabia and other nations were a big help, that Pakistan was neutral and would give only a couple of thousand, and that Turkey pretended to be a friend.
mentions.quote: The Lord said boots on the ground
mentions.falsify_match: A ground coalition forms with those alignments.
